coordinate_frame: ICRF equatorial axes; geometric Earth-centered vectors
orbit_acceptance: Maximum position-vector error <= 0.001 times the reference mean Earth-Moon distance
orientation_acceptance: Maximum geocentric sub-Earth longitude and latitude errors <= 1 degree each
initialization: Only first-epoch Moon and Sun state vectors, first-epoch Moon pole and sub-Earth longitude, plus independently specified mean sidereal rotation period. Later reference samples are used only for validation.
parameter_fitting: No fitting of force parameters, rotation rate, or initial states to later samples
numerical_check: Repeat three-body propagation at half the RK4 timestep and report the maximum difference
scope: One-month hindcast, not a spacecraft navigation ephemeris or a derivation of tidal capture
